item.title: 💌 Reflections of a First-Year PhD Student
item.description: Doing a PhD was a decision that came naturally to me. I loved gaining more knowledge, and a PhD would give me all the time in the world (okay, about 4 years) to delve into topics that interest me. Also, a PhD was the logical next step in achieving what I had dreamed of since I was in second grade (I wanted to be a professor by day and a princess by night lol.

item.title: About
item.description: Heylo! I’m Michelle, a second-year PhD student at the Chair for AI in Healthcare and Medicine at the Technical University of Munich, advised by Prof. Daniel Rueckert. 🫀 My research interest lies in developing deep learning-based models to predict clinical outcomes based on echocardiograms and other cardiac modalities like ECG. Research interest keywords: Echocardiography, multimodal learning, video understanding
